classification.difficultyReason: Identify two symmetric boundaries at two standard deviations from the mean and use the complement of the central 95%.

content.prompt:
Apple diameters are normally distributed with mean 68 mm and standard deviation 2 mm.
Apples are discarded if diameter is more than 72 mm or less than 64 mm.
What percentage are discarded?

answer.worked:
$\mu=68\text{ mm}$ and $\sigma=2\text{ mm}$.
$$\begin{aligned}z(64)&=\frac{64-68}{2}=-2\\z(72)&=\frac{72-68}{2}=2\end{aligned}$$
By the empirical rule, approximately $95\%$ of diameters lie within $\mu\pm2\sigma$, so these apples are accepted.
$$\text{Percentage discarded}=100\%-95\%=5\%.$$

spec.mathematics: The boundaries are mu minus two sigma and mu plus two sigma. The empirical rule assigns approximately 95% to the central interval and 2.5% to each tail.
